narration_estimate.status: unmeasured; replace with actual Piljae audio timings before production

hook.pattern: impossible-looking motion + reaction + one mechanism question
hook.line: 배가 물에 뜬 채 위층으로 올라갑니다. 처음 보면 기가 막히죠.
hook.emphasis: yellow text within the normal safe text size, short low hit; continuous gentle camera

clips.purpose: wide establishing view of the same single lock: boat approaches the open lower entrance; upper gate stays closed; chamber and lower canal levels match; only boat, wake and gentle camera move

clips.end_frame: approved same-lock approach frame; gate geometry and water levels preserved

clips.end_frame: approved wide boat exit frame with both lock ends in view

blender.camera_type: mostly wide or medium perspective tracking; stable side-of-lock orientation; full chamber context
groups: fixed upper and lower canal reaches
fixed lock chamber floor and walls
upper and lower paired mitre gates with separate hinge pivots
separate upper inflow and lower outflow sluices with explanatory water paths
one boat with hull, cabin glazing, fenders and restrained wake
chamber water surface moving vertically with the boat
removable explanatory near-wall cutaway and level markers
small lockside person and mooring bollards for scale
model_detail: gate timber grain, steel reinforcement and fasteners
concrete joints, waterline stains, dampness variation and fine aggregate
paint roughness variation, limited edge wear and small rust patches
rubber fenders and reflective cabin glazing
small water ripples and consistent wake
blender.materials: physically scaled procedural PBR textures; subtle normal and roughness variation; broad soft light, AgX and beveled edges; consistent exposure
blender.water_method: animated surface mesh, procedural normals, controlled water level and small wake; no large fluid simulation required

user_feedback: strong zooms hid the whole mechanism
phone safe areas made text at the very top hard to read

camera.rule: establish whole lock, explain from medium distance, return to whole lock after key actions; main objects stay readable

visual_direction.secondary_motion: small boat buoyancy motion, restrained wake, water ripples and gradual gate easing; no violent sloshing
visual_direction.texture_review: review one textured wide and one medium reference at phone size before full rendering; judge material distinction and whole mechanism readability

sound_design: original quiet canal ambience, low boat engine, gradual gate movement, inflow and outflow water; short low hit for the reveal; Piljae remains dominant
guards: upper and lower canal levels, chamber floor and walls remain fixed
boat floats at approximately constant draft and follows chamber water height; never rides a moving floor or lift
open entry or exit gates only after water levels on both sides match
never open both ends of the lock at once
close the lower outflow sluice before filling from the upper reach; close the upper inflow sluice before draining to the lower reach
do not animate water passing through closed solid gates, hulls or concrete; use the explicit sluice path
reverse-direction demonstration is identified as a separate example; do not teleport an exit boat back into the chamber
initial rise is a teaser; return to entry with a clear first-step cue
show the full boat, both ends and water level relation during the main explanation
texture must be visible in wide and medium views; avoid uniform plastic surfaces or oversized noise patterns
no abrupt punch-in; keep wide or medium shots for at least 80 percent of runtime
use shared layout v3: title and chips y=500-660, captions y=1140-1380, horizontal center x=540
test the longest two-line caption and reaction phrase against conservative phone UI masks; never claim these coordinates are universal device safe areas
use generic single-chamber lock geometry; do not claim site dimensions, transit times or an operating procedure
measure final Piljae narration before committing shot times; do not trim speech
each generated source duration must cover its final timeline span; recheck total 50 seconds after timing changes
